correctness.rationale: The downstairs finding is correct; the frozen proof's phrase ‘all canonical differential vanishing orders upstairs’ needs to be restricted to the invariant five-dimensional space (the full genus-45 space even has an order-zero section at P). The complete replacement repairs this scope statement and supplies an explicit independent derivation of the cancellation. Transpositions have 11 fixed points on the equal-coordinate line plus a negative-eigenline point; each three-cycle fixes the two nontrivial eigenpoints. Counting each fixed point for each nonidentity element yields ramification degree 40 and quotient genus 5. The rational P has stabilizer of order two. Plane adjunction uses degree-eight numerators; multiplying a degree-five symmetric form by the alternating Vandermonde yields the invariant numerator. The five symmetric monomials span this space, which is precisely the image of pullback. Locally t=Z at X=1 and 1+y=−t^11/11+O(t^22); the residue factor is a unit. The identity e1e2−e3=(X+Y)(X+Z)(Y+Z) gives exact order 11 with coefficient 1/11. The adapted basis has orders 1,3,5,11,13 and pivot-jet determinant 1/121 relative to the listed monomial basis. Distinct lowest orders cannot cancel. Pullback at index two obeys the order rule 2a+1; the downstairs orders therefore give the five gaps, weight 4 and the complementary semigroup generated by 4,5,11. Base change at rational Q gives a rational function with pole divisor precisely 4Q. A separate rational jet reproduction through t^13 is at /workspace/branches/182926d5-b694-4e4b-a508-c2e63a95a5af/local_series_check.py; the package replay script d11_weierstrass_check.py was inspected, not rerun. The jets check the local orders and minor, not the quotient geometry. Corrected file: repairs/2/RESULT.md.

value.rationale: P is a geometrically distinguished rational branch point, not a random point selected for a jet check. The two exceptional canonical orders give a weight-four point and settle the exact one-point pole filtration there, in particular producing a rational degree-four cover with a totally ramified fiber. Neither the genus nor the existence of a basis yields that conclusion without a local analysis. No global gonality or full census is claimed.
